# v1.1.0

###### 2026/09/16

* `Feature` The "AutoJs6" activity-bar view contains a "Devices (Devices)" list and "Device Files (Device Files)" tree for browsing, opening, editing, uploading, downloading, renaming and deleting device files and running scripts (requires AutoJs6 6.8.0+)
* `Feature` Upload multiple local folders from the device-files view, preserving subdirectories and empty directories, merging matching directories and overwriting matching files, with progress and cancellation
* `Feature` The `autojs6fs://` remote filesystem opens device files directly in the editor and saves them back; "Browse Device Files" adds a device directory to the workspace
* `Feature` QR connections: "Server | QR Code" displays this computer's connection code, and AutoJs6 6.8.0+ client mode connects after scanning _[`issue #12`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/12)_
* `Feature` Protocol v2: application-level heartbeats (ping/pong) detect half-open connections; extension-initiated LAN/ADB connections reconnect after unexpected disconnection _[`issue #3`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/3)_ _[`issue #13`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/13)_
* `Feature` Reconnection sessions use exponential backoff after unexpected disconnection, for 5 minutes by default with configurable attempts/window/maximum interval; VSCode restores the last connection after restarting (`autojs6.connection.restoreOnStartup`). Add "Reconnect last device (Reconnect)" and "Stop automatic reconnection (Cancel Reconnect)", with status-bar progress
* `Feature` Disconnection notice `bye`: either side informs the peer of explicit disconnection, preventing reconnection and startup restoration; VSCode sends `bye(shutdown)` on shutdown so AutoJs6 (6.8.0+) can reconnect later
* `Feature` Pairing confirmation offers "Allow and remember / Allow once / Deny" for unknown client-mode devices; QR connections use a one-time token for automatic trust. Add "Manage trusted devices (Manage Trusted Devices)" and `autojs6.server.confirmUnknownDevices`; AutoJs6 6.8.0+ shows "Waiting for VSCode confirmation"
* `Feature` LAN discovery (mDNS): "Client | LAN" automatically lists AutoJs6 6.8.0+ devices with server mode and LAN discovery enabled; disable with `autojs6.discovery.enabled`
* `Feature` Large transfers split reads/writes exceeding 1 MiB into 1 MiB chunks, with cancellable progress (AutoJs6 6.8.0+)
* `Feature` "Pull project changes from device (Pull Project from Device)" compares the device copy to the local project, lists added/modified files, previews per-file diffs and pulls selected changes (AutoJs6 6.8.0+ compares `md5` from `fs.list`; older versions compare contents)
* `Feature` Localization follows the VSCode display language (Simplified Chinese / English), including command titles and setting descriptions (vscode.l10n)
* `Feature` Status-bar device indicator for quickly selecting run, save, logs or disconnect actions
* `Feature` Settings (`autojs6.*`) cover listening ports, HTTP command-service address/port, adb path, connection/handshake/heartbeat timeouts, reconnection, log panels and relative save paths
* `Feature` Connection addresses accept hostnames and custom ports (`host:port`, `[ipv6]:port`) _[`issue #20`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/20)_
* `Feature` "Resynchronize entire project (Resync Project)" forces a complete overwrite of the device project _[`issue #29`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/29)_
* `Fix` Fix activation failures when port 6347/10347 is occupied, such as with multiple VSCode windows, causing all commands to report "not found" _[`issue #14`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/14)_ _[`issue #15`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/15)_
* `Fix` Fix device discovery on Linux / macOS when parsing `adb devices` with Windows line endings; add adb autodetection (`ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, common installation paths) and `autojs6.adb.path` _[`issue #35`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/35)_
* `Fix` Fix the inverted `override` flag during incremental sync and failed device deletion when `deletedFiles` contains backslashes on Windows (requires matching AutoJs6 6.8.0+) _[`issue #29`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/29)_
* `Fix` Fix "Stop current script" and "Save" selecting the wrong editor when focus is in the output panel
* `Fix` Fix exceptions from accessing disposed connections after handshake timeout or disconnection
* `Fix` Handle output panels after device disconnection: retain and mark them disconnected by default, or remove automatically with `autojs6.log.disposeChannelOnDisconnect` _[`issue #30`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/30)_
* `Fix` Remove port forwarding when an ADB connection closes
* `Fix` Fix occasional false "Cannot reconnect ..., stopped retrying" messages after unexpected disconnection (previously stopped after 5 attempts, about 31 s); show failure once at the end of the reconnection window with "Retry" / "Do not restore automatically"
* `Improvement` Include workspace-relative paths when saving/running files; AutoJs6 6.8.0+ preserves the directory structure in its working directory _[`issue #37`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/37)_
* `Improvement` The HTTP command service listens only on `127.0.0.1` by default (previously `0.0.0.0`), preventing other LAN hosts from invoking local commands
* `Improvement` Filter virtual interfaces such as Hyper-V / VirtualBox / Docker / WSL, and prioritize the default-gateway interface _[`issue #12`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/12)_
* `Improvement` Reduce QR-code density through a shorter payload and lower error correction, and add a size slider to help AutoJs6 focus when scanning
* `Improvement` Skip `ignore` directories such as `node_modules` directly during project traversal and remove full-package byte debug dumps
* `Improvement` Separate protocol/device/UI/remote-file/QR modules and add pure Node.js unit tests (`npm test`)
* `Improvement` Bundle with esbuild, reducing vsix from 9.6 MB to about 1 MB; replace `pinyin` / `systeminformation` with `tiny-pinyin` and system routing-table discovery
* `Improvement` Add port explanations and the `protocol.md` protocol document to README _[`issue #10`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/10)_

# v1.0.13

###### 2026/03/14

* `Improvement` Refactor device-side Socket framing: replace text headers with a fixed 8-byte binary header (int32BE length + type)
* `Improvement` Parse TCP streams with a cumulative-buffer frame loop for reliable partial and concatenated frames
* `Improvement` Validate frame types and maximum lengths to detect protocol desynchronization early and prevent abnormal memory growth
* `Improvement` Remove unnecessary string intermediates when sending JSON and binary data

# v1.0.12

###### 2025/04/14

* `Fix` Fix server-mode connection failures caused by incorrect version checks _[`issue #27`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/27)_
* `Improvement` New projects can use the `dts-link` script task to create a symlink to [AutoJs6 declarations](http://dts-project.autojs6.com/) automatically _[`issue #8`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/8)_
